text: The AlUla Tour's own partners page lists under 'Institutional Partners' the Ministère des sports (mos.gov.sa), the Saudi Cycling Federation (sacf.sa), AlUla (rcu.gov.sa) and Saudi Palmier Olympique (olympic.sa); the sole 'Main partner' is Manahil Nissan, and the 'Official Partners' are Nova, Alé and Budget Saudi Arabia. No title-sponsor tier exists - AlUla is the event name.
short: AlUla Tour partners: Saudi state bodies institutional, Manahil Nissan main
